## Functions

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ncdf4)
```


## Load data

```{r}
# og_stepps_post <- load("/Users/finleyjean/Documents/STEPPS-prediction-Ecology/og_STEPPS_products/lakes_stepps.RData")

mean_stepps <- nc_open("/Users/finleyjean/Documents/STEPPS-prediction-Ecology/og_STEPPS_products/2Kyrs_Comp_Mean_Level2_v1.0.nc")
```


```{r}
# spatio-temporal extraction (per 12 taxa)
x_coord <- ncvar_get(mean_stepps, "x")
y_coord <- ncvar_get(mean_stepps, "y")
time_vals <- ncvar_get(mean_stepps, "Time")

# 
taxa <- c("ASH", "BEECH", "BIRCH", "ELM", "HEMLOCK", "MAPLE", "OAK",
           "OTHER.CONIFER", "OTHER.HARDWOOD", "PINE", "SPRUCE", "TAMARACK")

# Extract proportions into long tibble
df_proportions <- lapply(taxa, function(taxa) {
  vals <- ncvar_get(mean_stepps, taxa)
  
  # vals has dimensions [x, y, Time]
  expand.grid(
    x = x_coord,
    y = y_coord,
    Time = time_vals
  ) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = as.vector(vals),
           Taxa = taxa)
})

ASH_proportions <- df_proportions[[1]]
BEECH_proportions<- df_proportions[[2]]
BIRCH_proportions<- df_proportions[[3]]
ELM_proportions<- df_proportions[[4]]
HEMLOCK_proportions <- df_proportions[[5]]
MAPLE_proportions<- df_proportions[[6]]
OAK_proportions<- df_proportions[[7]]
OTHER.CONIFER_proportions <- df_proportions[[8]]
OTHER.HARDWOOD_proportions<- df_proportions[[9]]
PINE_proportions<- df_proportions[[10]]
SPRUCE_proportions<- df_proportions[[11]]
TAMARACK_proportions<- df_proportions[[12]]

# finley is such an inefficient coder - so sorry
proportions_all <- bind_rows(ASH_proportions, BEECH_proportions, BIRCH_proportions, ELM_proportions, HEMLOCK_proportions, MAPLE_proportions, OAK_proportions, OTHER.CONIFER_proportions, OTHER.HARDWOOD_proportions, PINE_proportions, SPRUCE_proportions, TAMARACK_proportions)

# check locations present
unique((proportions_all)$x)
unique((proportions_all)$y)

# filter for only wisconsin varve locations
# 
pollen_locs_wisc_varve <- matrix(c(
  358152.4, 1001003,
  356758.9 ,1000213,
  356204.7 ,1001203
), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)

pollen_locs_wisc_varve <- as.data.frame(pollen_locs_wisc_varve)
colnames(pollen_locs_wisc_varve) <- c("x", "y")


###### NEED TO FILTER LOCATIONS STILL
# get_min_dist <- function(x, y, pollen_df) {
#   min(sqrt((pollen_df$x - x)^2 + (pollen_df$y - y)^2))
# }
# 
# proportions_all <- proportions_all %>%
#   rowwise() %>%
#   mutate(dist_to_pollen = get_min_dist(x, y, pollen_locs_wisc_varve)) %>%
#   ungroup()



coords <- as.matrix(proportions_all[, c("x", "y")])
pollen <- as.matrix(pollen_locs_wisc_varve)

# compute distances to each pollen site
dist_list <- lapply(1:nrow(pollen), function(i) {
  sqrt((coords[,1] - pollen[i,1])^2 + (coords[,2] - pollen[i,2])^2)
})

# combine and take minimum distance
proportions_all$dist_to_pollen <- do.call(pmin, dist_list)

proportions_filtered <-proportions_all %>% filter(dist_to_pollen < 10000)


# CHECK: 349000 x 1006000 = varve cells
print(unique(proportions_filtered$x))
print(unique(proportions_filtered$x))

```

## Plot Data

```{r}
label_df <- proportions_filtered %>%
  group_by(Taxa) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Time, n = 1) %>%   # last time point
  ungroup()

taxa_order <- label_df$Taxa

proportions_filtered$Taxa <- factor(proportions_filtered$Taxa,
                                    levels = taxa_order)

ggplot((proportions_filtered ), 
       aes(x = -Time, y = Proportion, group = Taxa, color = Taxa)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  expand_limits(x = max(-proportions_filtered$Time) * 1.1) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") # i want to sort the legend by label_df  

```
